name: Live Pulse
description: Radio traffic as it happens: a pulse on the node that just transmitted and a glowing arc along the part of its path your radio can actually see. Drawn in the browser, so the Raspberry Pi does no extra work.

dark_map.description: Darken the base map while Live Pulse is on (a filter on the map tiles, nothing extra is downloaded)

show_arcs.description: Draw arcs along the part of a packet's path that is known (needs a position for your own node)

persistence.description: How long pulses, arcs and afterglows stay on screen: short (about 2 s, no afterglow on nodes), normal (about 4 s, nodes glow for a minute), long (about 6 s, nodes glow for three minutes). The panel can change it per browser.

max_animations.description: Most pulses and arcs on screen at once; the oldest give way on a busy mesh
